about: Movie and series servers. The app plays the best 6 that are up, ranked by visual quality, then audio, then reliability (src/services/serverPoolRank.ts). The daily check (scripts/server-health.mjs) marks servers down or back up. Figures were measured on Inception (27205) from Kenya on 2026-10-21; null means it could not be measured, and the ranking then assumes a modest 2 Mb/s.

servers.name: VidRock
servers.note: 1080/720/360 HLS, up to 5 Mb/s. Played all 5 audit titles. Reports no playback events, so the next episode cannot start by itself here.

servers.name: VidZee
servers.note: Single 1080p stream at 4.5 Mb/s (no lower quality to fall back to on a slow line). Audio in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu. Played all 5 audit titles.

servers.name: VidLink
servers.note: 1080/720/480 DASH in H.265, which needs about half the bitrate of H.264 for the same picture. Played all 5 audit titles.

servers.name: Viduki
servers.note: Serves the same stream as VidZee (same bitrate and segments), so it shares VidZee's source. Played Inception and East of Eden S1E1.

servers.name: VidSrc.to
servers.note: Found all 5 audit titles. Its player is nested inside another site's frame, so quality could not be measured.

servers.name: 2Embed
servers.note: Found all 5 audit titles; quality could not be measured (nested player).

servers.name: VidSrc.me
servers.note: Reserve: takes a place when one of the six goes down.
